analysis_summary.zh:
【叙事校验】当前市场处于宏观BEAR环境，但日线价格均高于SMA50，呈现长期看涨短期回调的结构。Qlib全负分且推荐CASH，显示模型对短期上涨无信心。资金费率普遍为正且Z-Score极高（>100%），表明杠杆多头拥挤。24h爆仓量分布显示空单爆仓远超多单（BTC爆仓多空比0.04，ETH 0.11），空头已被大量挤压，但多头尚未经历清洗。鲸鱼数据方面，ETH出现大规模提币（24h +96万ETH），但稳定币流出，形成矛盾信号；SOL则出现充币抛售（-28万SOL）且稳定币流出，鲸鱼看空。综合来看，市场处于多头拥挤但动能衰竭的阶段，潜在陷阱是：若价格无法突破，拥挤多头可能成为挤压对象。
【决策依据】Qlib全负分，技术面RSI在60-65中性偏高，ADX<20显示趋势弱，布林带宽度中等，无极端信号。资金费率Z-Score异常高，OI变化ETH和SOL较大，但价格未同步上涨，存在背离。
【痛苦交易】空头已被大量爆仓（BTC爆仓多空比0.04），空头痛苦已释放；多头目前拥挤但未爆仓，若价格下跌，多头爆仓将加剧跌势。当前痛苦交易方向是：多头挤压（Long Squeeze）风险。
【剧本选择】选择MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE，因为资金费率高企、多头拥挤、价格停滞，一旦触发下跌，多头踩踏将提供做空机会。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation] Market is in macro BEAR environment, but daily prices above SMA50 show long-term bullish with short-term correction. Qlib all negative and recommends CASH, indicating model lacks confidence in short-term upside. Funding rates positive with extremely high Z-Scores (>100%), signaling crowded longs. 24h liquidation data shows short liquidations far exceed longs (BTC liq ratio 0.04, ETH 0.11), shorts already squeezed, but longs not yet flushed. Whale data: ETH large withdrawals (+961k ETH) but stablecoin outflow, mixed signal; SOL deposits (-280k SOL) with stablecoin outflow, bearish. Overall, crowded longs with fading momentum, potential trap: if price fails to break out, crowded longs may get squeezed.
[Decision Basis] Qlib all negative; RSI 60-65 neutral-high; ADX<20 weak trend; BB width moderate, no extremes. Funding Z-Score extremely high; OI change for ETH and SOL large but price not following, divergence.
[Pain Trade] Shorts already heavily liquidated (BTC liq ratio 0.04), short pain released; longs crowded but not yet liquidated, if price drops, long liquidations will accelerate downside. Current pain trade direction: Long Squeeze risk.
[Scenario Selection] Choose MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE because high funding, crowded longs, price stalling; if trigger downside, long stampede provides shorting opportunity.

analysis_summary.zh:
[叙事校验]：当前市场处于低波动性牛市环境，但1D级别显示BEAR市场状态，存在分歧。新闻焦点缺失，价格走势平淡，无明显新驱动。QLib模型预测ETH、DOGE、BNB相对强势，但技术指标如RSI（51-56）和ADX（11-15）显示趋势疲软，无强烈方向性。宏观上美元走强（DXY 98.37）带来风险规避压力，但美联储利率稳定，未引发恐慌。整体判断为动能衰竭，价格可能进入盘整。
[决策依据详情]：ETH Qlib分数0.0079排名第一，但RSI 51.41、ADX 15.2、均线偏离度-0.62%显示弱势；鲸鱼代币流向24h提币242,966.6 ETH（看涨），但稳定币流出$7,982,249（看跌），形成矛盾。DOGE Qlib分数0.0075排名第二，但RSI 50.02、ADX 14.8、均线偏离度-0.44%中性；爆仓多空比120.93极高，显示多头受压显著。BNB Qlib分数0.0056排名第三，RSI 55.07稍强，但ADX 13.9低，OI变化6.67%增加可能带来波动。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比，DOGE多头最痛苦（爆仓多空比120.93），ETH和SOL空头较痛苦（爆仓多空比0.64和0.65），但整体爆仓量低，无大规模强制平仓风险。持仓L/S比显示DOGE大户账户数比1.41（多头拥挤），但持仓量比0.78（空头主导），存在潜在多头挤压。ETH大户账户数比1.02接近平衡，持仓量比0.96略空。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为技术指标中性、波动率低、无强烈趋势信号，且鲸鱼流向矛盾，适合在极端情绪时反转交易。未选TREND_FOLLOWING因动量不足（平均动量0.0176低），未选MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE因爆仓数据不极端。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Market is in low-volatility bullish environment but 1D shows BEAR state, indicating divergence. No major news, price action flat, no new drivers. QLib predicts ETH, DOGE, BNB relative strength, but technicals like RSI (51-56) and ADX (11-15) show weak trends. Macro-wise, DXY strengthening (98.37) adds risk-off pressure, but Fed rate stable. Overall, momentum exhaustion likely leading to consolidation.
[Decision Details]: ETH Qlib score 0.0079 rank 1, but RSI 51.41, ADX 15.2, SMA deviation -0.62% weak; whale token flow 24h withdrawal 242,966.6 ETH (bullish) vs stablecoin outflow $7,982,249 (bearish), creating conflict. DOGE Qlib score 0.0075 rank 2, but RSI 50.02, ADX 14.8, SMA deviation -0.44% neutral; liquidation ratio 120.93 extremely high, indicating long pressure. BNB Qlib score 0.0056 rank 3, RSI 55.07 stronger, but ADX 13.9 low, OI change 6.67% may increase volatility.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation ratios, DOGE longs most pained (ratio 120.93), ETH and SOL shorts pained (ratios 0.64 and 0.65), but overall liquidation volumes low, no large-scale forced exits. L/S ratios show DOGE whale account ratio 1.41 (crowded long) vs position ratio 0.78 (short-dominated), potential long squeeze. ETH whale account ratio 1.02 balanced, position ratio 0.96 slightly short.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook due to neutral technicals, low volatility, lack of strong trends, and conflicting whale flows, suitable for reversal at extremes. Rejected TREND_FOLLOWING due to insufficient momentum (avg 0.0176 low), rejected MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE due to non-extreme liquidation data.

analysis_summary.zh: [叙事校验]：当前市场处于中性偏熊环境（1D RSI均低于60），但无重大新闻驱动，价格窄幅震荡，属于动能衰竭阶段。QLib模型显示ETH、BNB、SOL相对强势，但技术指标（RSI 40-50，MACD负值）表明短期动能不足。宏观上，VIX上升和DXY走强暗示风险规避情绪，但美联储利率稳定，未提供新催化剂。[决策依据详情]：ETH Qlib分数最高（0.0118），但RSI 43.77低于中性，ADX 15.1显示趋势弱；SOL资金费率Z-score高达67.5%，但代币流向为负（充币抛售），形成看跌分歧；BTC爆仓多空比1.30显示多头受压，但价格接近SMA50（偏离-0.31%），支撑较强。[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓数据，BTC多头最痛苦（爆仓多空比1.30），ETH和SOL空头更痛苦（爆仓多空比0.94和0.70），但持仓L/S比显示ETH大户账户多空比1.10（略偏多），SOL大户账户多空比1.25（偏多），可能形成多头陷阱。[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION，因技术指标（RSI中性偏低，MACD负值）和情绪极端（SOL资金费率Z-score高）提供反转机会，且价格接近关键均线（如BTC SMA50），风险回报比优于趋势跟随。
analysis_summary.en: [Narrative Validation]: Market is in a neutral-bearish environment (1D RSI all below 60) with no major news, price consolidating in a narrow range, indicating momentum exhaustion. QLib model shows ETH, BNB, SOL as relatively strong, but technicals (RSI 40-50, negative MACD) suggest short-term weakness. Macro-wise, rising VIX and stronger DXY imply risk-off sentiment, but stable Fed rates provide no new catalyst. [Decision Details]: ETH has highest Qlib score (0.0118) but RSI 43.77 below neutral, ADX 15.1 shows weak trend; SOL funding Z-score is high at 67.5% but token flow negative (to exchange), creating bearish divergence; BTC liquidation ratio 1.30 indicates long pain, but price near SMA50 (deviation -0.31%) offers support. [Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation data, BTC longs are most pained (liquidation ratio 1.30), while ETH and SOL shorts are more pained (ratios 0.94 and 0.70), but持仓L/S比 shows ETH whale account ratio 1.10 (slightly long-biased) and SOL 1.25 (long-biased), potentially forming long traps. [Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION, as technicals (neutral-low RSI, negative MACD) and sentiment extremes (high SOL funding Z-score) offer reversal opportunities, with price near key MAs (e.g., BTC SMA50), providing better risk-reward than trend-following.

red_team_audit.zh: [强制对立面]：如果判断错误，最可能的原因是趋势延续而非反转。QLib模型显示ETH、BNB、SOL排名靠前，可能预示上涨动量；全球宏观风险规避（VIX高）可能压制所有资产，导致进一步下跌；SOL资金费率Z-score高但代币流向负，可能只是短期调整而非反转信号；BTC爆仓多空比1.30若缓解，可能引发空头回补上涨。数据支撑：ETH Qlib分数0.0118（最强），平均动量0.0141（积极），BNB和SOL排名2-3。
red_team_audit.en: [Forced Contra-Argument]: If the thesis is wrong, the most likely reason is trend continuation rather than reversal. QLib model ranks ETH, BNB, SOL top, potentially indicating upward momentum; global macro risk-off (high VIX) could suppress all assets, leading to further declines; SOL high funding Z-score with negative token flow might be a short-term correction, not a reversal signal; BTC liquidation ratio 1.30 easing could trigger short-covering rallies. Supporting data: ETH Qlib score 0.0118 (strongest), average momentum 0.0141 (positive), BNB and SOL ranks 2-3.

Additionally, ETH token flow positive (from exchange) is bullish, but price decline creates divergence. Risk point: If market suddenly driven by macro positives (e.g., rate cut expectations), it could break consolidation, leading to missed trend-following opportunities. Justification: QLib scores are high but technicals (RSI, MACD) weak, and funding Z-scores extreme (e.g., SOL 67.5%) support reversal; ETH flow bullish but price unresponsive may accumulate for later breakout, but current risk-reward is insufficient.

Data supporting opposite view: ETH stablecoin outflow ($-7.98M 24h) indicates capital exit, RSI 45.95 <50 suggests downside risk; SOL sustained token outflow (7d=-811.6K SOL) may signal larger selling pressure.

analysis_summary.zh:
[叙事校验]：当前市场处于中性震荡，宏观背景稳定（美联储利率、DXY、VIX均中性），无重大新闻驱动。价格走势与数据呈现分歧：ETH Qlib排名第一（0.0103），但鲸鱼代币流向显示24h提币囤货（+3.39M ETH），而稳定币流出（-$13.2M），表明鲸鱼在积累资产但资金离场，形成看涨背离。SOL Qlib排名第二（0.0039），但鲸鱼代币流向为充币抛售（-94.9K SOL），稳定币流出（-$134K），技术面中性（RSI 50.4），存在看跌压力。BTC Qlib排名最差（0.0003），但技术面偏强（RSI 56.4，均线偏离+1.45%），爆仓多空比极低（0.21），显示空头被挤压风险。整体市场情绪中性（平均资金费率0.0054%），波动率低（平均ATR 1.65%），无新冲动能，属于动能衰竭阶段。
[决策依据详情]：ETH：Qlib分数0.0103（最高），RSI 48.47（中性偏弱），ADX 15.3（趋势弱），上影线34%/下影线27%（抛压略高），均线偏离-0.66%（价格低于SMA50），爆仓多空比0.75（多头略受压）。SOL：Qlib分数0.0039，RSI 49.92（中性），ADX 13.7（趋势很弱），上影线16%/下影线32%（支撑较强），均线偏离-0.06%（接近均线），爆仓多空比0.24（空头被严重挤压）。BTC：Qlib分数0.0003（最低），RSI 56.24（偏强），ADX 18.1（趋势中等），上影线35%/下影线18%（抛压高），均线偏离+1.45%（价格高于SMA50），爆仓多空比0.21（空头极度受压）。数据显著性：ETH的鲸鱼代币流向（+3.39M ETH）与价格停滞形成看涨背离，SOL的鲸鱼代币流向（-94.9K SOL）与中性技术面形成看跌信号，BTC的爆仓多空比（0.21）显示空头陷阱风险。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比和L/S比，SOL和BTC的空头处于强制平仓边缘：SOL爆仓多空比0.24（空单爆仓$221.9K远多于多单$53.1K），持仓L/S比（账户数1.24/持仓量0.87）显示散户看多但大户看空，空头拥挤易被轧空；BTC爆仓多空比0.21（空单爆仓$8.65M远多于多单$1.82M），持仓L/S比（账户数0.62/持仓量1.04）显示大户看多但散户看空，空头极度受压。ETH多头略受压（爆仓多空比0.75），但鲸鱼提币提供支撑。
[剧本选择]：选择MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE剧本，因为当前微观结构显示空头陷阱：SOL和BTC的爆仓多空比极低（<0.3），空头拥挤且资金费率中性偏正（SOL 0.0056%，BTC 0.0035%），价格持有关键水平（BTC高于SMA50，SOL接近均线），强制空头平仓可能推动价格上涨。此剧本胜算高，因数据融合了爆仓痛苦、持仓拥挤和鲸鱼流向（ETH看涨背离提供额外信心）。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Market is in neutral consolidation with stable macro (Fed rate, DXY, VIX neutral) and no major news. Price action diverges from data: ETH ranks top in Qlib (0.0103) but whale token flow shows accumulation (+3.39M ETH) while stablecoin outflow (-$13.2M), indicating bullish divergence. SOL ranks second (0.0039) but whale token flow is selling (-94.9K SOL) with stablecoin outflow (-$134K), technicals neutral (RSI 50.4), bearish pressure. BTC ranks worst (0.0003) but technicals strong (RSI 56.4, SMA deviation +1.45%), liquidation ratio very low (0.21), signaling short squeeze risk. Overall sentiment neutral (avg funding 0.0054%), volatility low (avg ATR 1.65%), no new impulse, momentum exhaustion phase.
[Decision Details]: ETH: Qlib score 0.0103 (highest), RSI 48.47 (neutral-weak), ADX 15.3 (weak trend), wick ratio 34%/27% (selling pressure略高), SMA deviation -0.66% (price below SMA50), liquidation ratio 0.75 (longs略受压). SOL: Qlib score 0.0039, RSI 49.92 (neutral), ADX 13.7 (very weak trend), wick ratio 16%/32% (strong support), SMA deviation -0.06% (near SMA), liquidation ratio 0.24 (shorts severely squeezed). BTC: Qlib score 0.0003 (lowest), RSI 56.24 (strong), ADX 18.1 (moderate trend), wick ratio 35%/18% (high selling pressure), SMA deviation +1.45% (price above SMA50), liquidation ratio 0.21 (shorts extremely squeezed). Significance: ETH whale token flow (+3.39M ETH) vs price stagnation shows bullish divergence, SOL whale token flow (-94.9K SOL) vs neutral techs shows bearish signal, BTC liquidation ratio (0.21) indicates short trap risk.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation ratios and L/S ratios, SOL and BTC shorts are near forced exit: SOL liquidation ratio 0.24 (short liq $221.9K >> long $53.1K), L/S ratio (accounts 1.24/position 0.87) shows retail long but whales short, crowded shorts prone to squeeze; BTC liquidation ratio 0.21 (short liq $8.65M >> long $1.82M), L/S ratio (accounts 0.62/position 1.04) shows whales long but retail short, shorts extremely pressured. ETH longs略受压 (liquidation ratio 0.75) but whale withdrawals provide support.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE playbook because current microstructure shows short traps: SOL and BTC have very low liquidation ratios (<0.3), crowded shorts with neutral-positive funding (SOL 0.0056%, BTC 0.0035%), price holding key levels (BTC above SMA50, SOL near SMA), forced short covering may drive price up. This scenario scores high due to data confluence of liquidation pain, crowded positions, and whale flow (ETH bullish divergence adds confidence).

red_team_audit.en: If my thesis is wrong, the most likely reasons are: 1) Whale flows may lag or mislead: ETH withdrawals could be short-term, not long-term bullish, and stablecoin outflow (-$13.2M) suggests capital exit, price may fall further. 2) Very low liquidation ratios may indicate shorts already covered, not imminent squeeze, price may lack upward momentum. 3) Stable macro but no catalyst could lead to deeper consolidation, not breakout. Data supporting opposite view: ETH RSI 48.47 weak, ADX 15.3 weak trend, price below SMA50, bearish technically; SOL whale token flow selling (-94.9K SOL) directly bearish; BTC has lowest Qlib score (0.0003), indicating relative weakness.

contrary_signal_check.en: Most significant contrary signals or risks: 1) ETH stablecoin outflow (-$13.2M) contradicts bullish divergence, may weaken upside. 2) SOL Qlib score (0.0039) high but whale token flow selling (-94.9K SOL) directly bearish. 3) BTC Qlib rank worst (0.0003), strong techs but quant model not favorable. These don't invalidate the trade because: 1) ETH whale token withdrawals (+3.39M ETH) are stronger signal, stablecoin outflow may be short-term. 2) SOL's very low liquidation ratio (0.24) and crowded shorts are primary drivers, whale flow secondary. 3) BTC's liquidation ratio (0.21) and short pain are core, low Qlib score may reflect short-term noise.

analysis_summary.zh:
[叙事校验]：当前市场整体处于熊市环境（BEAR），但宏观背景中性（美联储利率稳定，VIX正常回落）。价格走势与新闻无明显新驱动，属于情绪分歧阶段。QLib模型预测ETH、BNB、SOL相对强势，但实际价格均下跌（ETH -0.30%，BNB -0.26%，SOL -0.23%），显示量化信号与价格行动存在轻微背离。
[决策依据详情]：ETH Qlib分数最高（0.0141），但RSI（39.86）超卖，ADX（18.9）趋势弱，上影线比率8%低于下影线14%表明抛压相对托底力度较弱。BNB技术面较好（RSI 44.89，ADX 22.9，均线偏离+0.69%），但缺乏鲸鱼数据。SOL鲸鱼情绪分24h=0.30（积极），但代币流向24h=-89,300.6 SOL（充币抛售），形成矛盾信号。
[痛苦交易]：BTC、ETH、SOL、DOGE的爆仓多空比均高于1.48（最高SOL 2.33），显示多头正在遭受强平痛苦，空头相对安全。持仓L/S比显示ETH大户账户数比1.07（略偏多），但持仓量比0.94（略偏空），表明零售可能看多而鲸鱼谨慎。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为多个资产RSI超卖（ETH 39.86，DOGE 42.72），爆仓多空比高显示多头已部分清洗，价格可能短期反弹。TREND_FOLLOWING被拒绝因整体趋势熊市且动量负值；MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE被拒绝因空头未明显拥挤（持仓L/S比未极端）。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Overall market is bearish (BEAR), but macro context neutral (Fed rate stable, VIX normal). Price action shows no new drivers, indicating sentiment divergence. QLib predicts ETH, BNB, SOL relative strength, but actual prices are down (ETH -0.30%, BNB -0.26%, SOL -0.23%), suggesting slight divergence between quant signals and price.
[Decision Details]: ETH has highest Qlib score (0.0141), but RSI (39.86) oversold, ADX (18.9) weak trend, upper wick ratio 8% vs lower 14% indicates weaker selling pressure. BNB technicals better (RSI 44.89, ADX 22.9, SMA deviation +0.69%), but lacks whale data. SOL whale sentiment 24h=0.30 (positive), but token flow 24h=-89,300.6 SOL (to exchange), creating conflicting signals.
[Pain Trade]: Liquidation long/short ratios for BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE all above 1.48 (highest SOL 2.33), showing longs are suffering liquidation pain, shorts relatively safe. Position L/S ratios show ETH large account ratio 1.07 (slightly long-biased) but position volume ratio 0.94 (slightly short-biased), indicating retail may be long while whales cautious.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook, as multiple assets have oversold RSI (ETH 39.86, DOGE 42.72), high liquidation ratios suggest longs partially flushed, price may rebound short-term. TREND_FOLLOWING rejected due to overall bearish trend and negative momentum; MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE rejected as shorts not heavily crowded (position L/S ratios not extreme).

analysis_summary.zh:
【叙事校验】当前市场整体处于熊市环境（BEAR），但长期趋势多数看涨，呈现矛盾状态。QLib模型显示ETH、BTC、DOGE相对强势，但技术指标普遍偏弱（RSI 46-54，MACD负值）。宏观背景中性（美联储利率稳定，VIX正常），无重大新闻驱动，属于存量博弈阶段。价格走势与数据出现分歧：ETH Qlib排名第一但24h鲸鱼代币流向为-1,365,197 ETH（充币抛售），稳定币流出$39.7M，显示大户在出货，而散户可能因负资金费率（-0.0131%）和爆仓多空比1.33（多头受压）被套。这暗示当前上涨动能可能衰竭，而非新信号触发。
【决策依据详情】ETH的RSI 46.29（中性偏弱）、ADX 18.2（趋势弱）、上影线比率11%/下影线56%（托底强于抛压），但鲸鱼代币流向24h为负且稳定币流出，与Qlib高分背离。BTC爆仓多空比2.21（多头痛苦显著），但持仓L/S比显示大户账户数空头占优（0.70），可能酝酿空头轧空。DOGE资金费率正0.0064%但OI下降-2.77%，显示杠杆降温。
【痛苦交易】基于爆仓多空比：BTC 2.21、DOGE 1.78、SOL 1.89、ETH 1.33，多头普遍受压，空头相对安全。持仓L/S比显示DOGE大户账户数多空比1.56（多头拥挤），但持仓量比0.75（空头实力强），可能形成多头陷阱。ETH鲸鱼24h代币流出+稳定币流出，表明大户在离场，散户多头易被清洗。
【剧本选择】选择MEAN_REVERSION，因为：1) 价格与鲸鱼流向出现叙事分歧（ETH高分但大户抛售）；2) 技术指标处于中性区域（RSI 46-54），无强趋势信号；3) 爆仓多空比高显示多头痛苦，但持仓结构显示空头可能过度拥挤（如BTC），适合反向操作。TREND_FOLLOWING被拒绝因趋势弱（ADX低）且鲸鱼流向矛盾；MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE被拒绝因无明确轧空触发点（如极端资金费率）。
analysis_summary.en:
Narrative Synthesis: The overall market is in a bearish regime (BEAR) but with bullish long-term trends, creating a contradictory state. QLib model shows ETH, BTC, DOGE as relatively strong, but technicals are weak (RSI 46-54, MACD negative). Macro context is neutral (Fed rate stable, VIX normal), with no major news drivers, indicating a存量博弈 phase. Price action diverges from data: ETH ranks #1 in Qlib but has 24h whale token flow of -1,365,197 ETH (to exchange) and stablecoin outflow of $39.7M, suggesting institutional selling, while retail may be trapped by negative funding (-0.0131%) and liquidation long/short ratio of 1.33 (longs pressured). This implies upward momentum may be fading, not a new signal trigger.
Decision Details: ETH's RSI 46.29 (weak-neutral), ADX 18.2 (weak trend), wick ratio 11% upper/56% lower (support > pressure), but whale token flow negative and stablecoin outflow contradict Qlib high score. BTC liquidation ratio 2.21 (longs suffering), but whale L/S ratio shows more short accounts (0.70), potentially setting up a short squeeze. DOGE funding positive 0.0064% but OI down -2.77%, indicating leverage cooling.
Pain Trade: Based on liquidation ratios: BTC 2.21, DOGE 1.78, SOL 1.89, ETH 1.33—longs are generally pressured, shorts relatively safe. Whale L/S ratios show DOGE has crowded longs (account ratio 1.56) but strong short positions (position ratio 0.75), risking a long trap. ETH whale outflows (token + stablecoin) suggest institutions exiting, making retail longs vulnerable.
Scenario Selection: MEAN_REVERSION chosen because: 1) Narrative divergence between price and whale flows (ETH high score but selling); 2) Technicals in neutral zone (RSI 46-54), no strong trend signals; 3) High liquidation ratios show long pain, but positioning indicates shorts may be overcrowded (e.g., BTC), suitable for fading. TREND_FOLLOWING rejected due to weak trend (low ADX) and contradictory whale flows; MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE rejected due to lack of clear squeeze triggers (e.g., extreme funding).

red_team_audit.zh: 【红色突击队审计】如果我的判断错误，最可能的反向理由是：1) Qlib模型可能准确预测了短期反弹，忽略鲸鱼流出作为滞后指标，价格可能因散户FOMO继续上涨。2) BTC爆仓多空比2.21显示多头已被大量清洗，抛压衰竭，可能触发反弹而非进一步下跌。3) 宏观环境稳定（美联储中性），可能支撑市场情绪，导致均值回归失效。数据支撑反面结论：ETH的7d代币流向为正8,410,272.6 ETH（提币囤货），暗示长期看涨；SOL鲸鱼评分24h=0.14（正面），可能带动altcoin上涨。
red_team_audit.en: Forced Contra-Argument: If my thesis is WRONG, the most likely reasons are: 1) Qlib model may accurately predict a short-term bounce, with whale outflows as lagging indicators, and price could rise due to retail FOMO. 2) BTC liquidation ratio of 2.21 indicates longs have been flushed, selling pressure may be exhausted, triggering a rebound rather than further decline. 3) Stable macro environment (Fed neutral) could support sentiment, causing mean reversion to fail. Data supporting opposite view: ETH's 7d token flow is positive 8,410,272.6 ETH (from exchange), suggesting long-term bullishness; SOL whale score 24h=0.14 (positive), potentially boosting altcoins.

contrary_signal_check.zh: 【冲突信号】1) ETH Qlib分数0.0136排名第一，与鲸鱼流出矛盾，可能预示短期强势。2) BTC持仓L/S比显示大户账户数空头占优（0.70），但持仓量多头占优（1.03），结构复杂，空头轧空风险存在。3) DOGE资金费率正0.0064%，显示多头情绪，可能抵消技术弱势。这些不会推翻交易结论，因为：QLib分数差异小（ETH 0.0136 vs BTC 0.0098），显著性不足；BTC空头账户多但持仓量少，表明散户空头可能被轧，但爆仓多空比2.21显示多头痛苦更大，优先处理；DOGE正资金费率但OI下降，显示杠杆降温而非新买盘。
contrary_signal_check.en: List the most significant contrary signal or risk point and justify why it doesn't invalidate the trade: 1) ETH Qlib score 0.0136 ranks #1, contradicting whale outflows, possibly indicating short-term strength. 2) BTC whale L/S ratio shows more short accounts (0.70) but long positions (1.03), complex structure with short squeeze risk. 3) DOGE funding positive 0.0064%, showing bullish sentiment, may offset technical weakness. These don't invalidate the trade because: Qlib score differences are small (ETH 0.0136 vs BTC 0.0098), lacking significance; BTC has many short accounts but low position size, suggesting retail shorts may be squeezed, but liquidation ratio 2.21 indicates greater long pain, prioritized; DOGE positive funding but OI decline shows leverage cooling, not new buying pressure.

[决策依据详情]：DOGE Qlib分数最高(-0.0008)，但所有分数为负，市场整体疲软。技术面：ETH RSI 43.4，ADX 33.1，上影线比率36%高于下影线10%，显示抛压；SOL RSI 40.9，ADX 45.5，偏离SMA50 -6.36%，超卖但趋势强。鲸鱼数据：ETH代币流向24h提币244万ETH（看涨），但稳定币流出$319k（看跌），分歧明显；SOL代币流向24h充币53.5万SOL（看跌），稳定币流出$217k（看跌），一致看跌。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比，SOL为10.20，ETH为3.56，DOGE为3.37，BNB高达149.89，显示多头正遭受强平痛苦，尤其是BNB和SOL。持仓L/S比中，DOGE大户账户数比1.70最高，但持仓量比0.76较低，可能有多头拥挤风险。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因技术指标超卖（RSI<45）、爆仓多空比极高显示多头痛苦，但鲸鱼流向分歧，价格可能短期反弹。MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE被拒绝因无明确拥挤空头；TREND_FOLLOWING被拒绝因趋势向下且Qlib分数全负。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Market is in bearish regime with all assets below SMA50, RSI in 30-45 range indicating oversold but not extreme. Macro context shows VIX at 31.05 (panic rising), DXY stronger, risk-off sentiment, but Fed rate stable, no new drivers. Price action aligns with negative sentiment, suggesting momentum exhaustion rather than new impulse.
[Decision Details]: DOGE has highest Qlib score (-0.0008), but all scores negative, overall weakness. Technicals: ETH RSI 43.4, ADX 33.1, upper wick ratio 36% vs lower 10% indicates selling pressure; SOL RSI 40.9, ADX 45.5, deviation from SMA50 -6.36%, oversold with strong trend. Whale data: ETH token flow 24h withdrawal 2.44M ETH (bullish) but stablecoin outflow $319k (bearish), divergence; SOL token flow 24h deposit 535k SOL (bearish) and stablecoin outflow $217k (bearish), consistent bearish.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation long/short ratios, SOL at 10.20, ETH at 3.56, DOGE at 3.37, BNB at 149.89, showing longs are suffering liquidation pain, especially in BNB and SOL. In L/S ratios, DOGE has highest account ratio 1.70 but lower position ratio 0.76, indicating potential crowded long risk.
[Scenario Selection]: Chose MEAN_REVERSION playbook due to oversold technicals (RSI<45), high liquidation ratios indicating long pain, but divergent whale flows suggesting potential short-term bounce. MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE rejected due to no clear crowded short side; TREND_FOLLOWING rejected due to downward trend and all negative Qlib scores.

red_team_audit.zh: 如果判断错误，最可能的反向理由是：市场恐慌持续，VIX上升和美元走强可能引发进一步抛售，导致超卖状态恶化。数据支撑：所有资产Qlib分数为负，宏观风险偏好低，鲸鱼稳定币流出（ETH和SOL）显示资金离场，可能压制反弹。价格可能跌破关键支撑（如ETH的SMA50偏离-4.40%），触发更多多头止损。
red_team_audit.en: If the thesis is wrong, the most likely reason is continued market panic, with rising VIX and stronger DXY triggering further sell-offs, worsening oversold conditions. Supporting data: all assets have negative Qlib scores, macro risk-off sentiment, whale stablecoin outflows (ETH and SOL) indicate capital leaving, potentially suppressing bounce. Price could break key supports (e.g., ETH deviation from SMA50 -4.40%), triggering more long stop-losses.

contrary_signal_check.zh: 最明显的冲突信号：鲸鱼代币流向分歧（ETH提币看涨但稳定币流出看跌），以及宏观风险环境（VIX恐慌、美元强）。解释：分歧可能反映机构积累但零售恐慌，短期反弹仍可能；宏观风险已部分定价，技术超卖提供缓冲。
contrary_signal_check.en: Most significant contrary signals: divergent whale token flows (ETH withdrawal bullish but stablecoin outflow bearish) and macro risk environment (VIX panic, DXY strong). Justification: divergence may indicate institutional accumulation vs retail panic, allowing short-term bounce; macro risks are partially priced in, with oversold technicals providing cushion.

【决策依据详情】DOGE的QLIB分数0.0023显著高于其他币种（第二名BNB仅0.0004），RSI 45.11处于中性偏弱区域，资金费率-0.0007%接近中性。ETH的鲸鱼代币流向24h=+486,331.9 ETH（提币囤货）与价格下跌形成明显背离，属于隐藏吸筹信号。SOL的鲸鱼代币流向持续为负（24h=-664,608.9 SOL充币抛售），但爆仓多空比高达67.11显示空头已被大量轧平。
【痛苦交易】根据24h爆仓数据：SOL（多空比67.11）、BTC（4.54）、ETH（3.75）均显示多头遭受显著强平痛苦，而空头仓位相对较轻。持仓L/S比显示：DOGE大户账户数比1.67但持仓量比仅0.73，表明散户多头拥挤但大户持仓谨慎。SOL大户账户数比1.79但持仓量比0.83，同样显示散户多头过度拥挤。
【剧本选择】选择NARRATIVE_DIVERGENCE剧本：ETH出现明显的价格下跌与鲸鱼提币囤货的背离（隐藏吸筹），同时SOL空头已被大量轧平（爆仓多空比67.11）但价格仍未反弹，存在均值回归潜力。拒绝TREND_FOLLOWING因为整体趋势为熊市且动量偏弱；拒绝MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE因为当前没有明显的单边拥挤仓位需要轧平。

1. [Narrative Validation]: Market is in bearish regime (BTC RSI_1D=41.3) but 4H shows range-bound consolidation (avg BB width 0.0534). QLIB indicates DOGE and BNB relative strength (top two ranks) but overall momentum is weak (avg -0.002). Macro: VIX 31.05 shows nervous sentiment, DXY 100.15 strengthening creates risk-off pressure. Price action vs news/macro shows 'momentum exhaustion'—no new drivers, price hovering below key MAs.
2. [Decision Details]: DOGE's QLIB score 0.0023 significantly outperforms others (BNB only 0.0004), RSI 45.11 neutral-weak, funding -0.0007% near neutral. ETH shows clear divergence: whale token flow +486,331.9 ETH (withdrawal/accumulation) while price declines—hidden accumulation signal. SOL whale token flow remains negative (-664,608.9 SOL deposit/selling) but liquidation L/S ratio 67.11 shows shorts already heavily squeezed.
3. [Pain Trade]: Based on 24h liquidation data: SOL (67.11), BTC (4.54), ETH (3.75) all show longs suffering significant pain, while short positions are relatively light. L/S ratios show: DOGE whale account ratio 1.67 but position ratio only 0.73, indicating retail long crowding but whale caution; SOL similar pattern (1.79 vs 0.83).
4. [Scenario Selection]: Choose NARRATIVE_DIVERGENCE playbook: ETH shows clear price-whale flow divergence (hidden accumulation), while SOL shorts already heavily squeezed but price hasn't rebounded, creating mean reversion potential. Reject TREND_FOLLOWING due to overall bearish trend and weak momentum; reject MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE because no clear one-sided crowded position needs squeezing currently.

【决策依据详情】SOL Qlib排名第一（分数0.0005），但RSI 34.38超卖，ADX 43.0显示强趋势，鲸鱼代币流向为负（-651,843.4 SOL充币抛售），稳定币流出（$-219,856），形成数据冲突。ETH和BTC的爆仓多空比极高（6.15和4.44），显示多头受压显著。
【痛苦交易】基于爆仓数据：SOL多头爆仓$1,104,941 vs 空头$21,373（多空比51.70），ETH多头爆仓$7,275,759 vs 空头$1,183,759（多空比6.15），BTC多头爆仓$5,969,873 vs 空头$1,345,675（多空比4.44）。持仓L/S比显示大户账户数多空比偏高（SOL 1.74，ETH 1.57，BTC 1.34），但持仓量多空比偏低（SOL 0.84，ETH 0.87，BTC 0.93），表明散户多头拥挤，面临强制平仓风险。
【剧本选择】选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为技术指标（RSI超卖）与鲸鱼流向（抛售）冲突，且多头拥挤（高爆仓多空比），价格可能短期反弹但缺乏持续上涨动力，适合逆势交易。

Narrative Synthesis: Market is in bearish regime (1D RSI all below 45) but neutral on 4H. Macro shows VIX at 31.05 (extreme panic), DXY strong at 100.15, risk-off sentiment. Price action lacks new drivers, indicating momentum exhaustion.
Decision Details: SOL ranks top in Qlib (score 0.0005) but RSI 34.38 oversold, ADX 43.0 strong trend, whale token flow negative (-651,843.4 SOL to exchange), stablecoin outflow ($-219,856), creating data divergence. ETH and BTC have high liquidation ratios (6.15 and 4.44), showing long pressure.
Pain Trade: Liquidation data: SOL long liq $1,104,941 vs short $21,373 (ratio 51.70), ETH long $7,275,759 vs short $1,183,759 (ratio 6.15), BTC long $5,969,873 vs short $1,345,675 (ratio 4.44). Whale L/S ratios show high account long bias (SOL 1.74, ETH 1.57, BTC 1.34) but low position bias (SOL 0.84, ETH 0.87, BTC 0.93), indicating crowded retail longs at risk of forced exit.
Scenario Selection: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook due to conflict between technicals (oversold RSI) and whale flow (selling), plus crowded longs (high liq ratios), suggesting potential short-term bounce but lack of sustained upside, suitable for contrarian trade.

analysis_summary.zh:
【叙事校验】当前市场处于熊市环境（所有资产价格低于SMA50，RSI_1D在41-45），但日内波动中性。宏观上美元走强（DXY 100.15）和VIX恐慌指数高企（31.05）带来风险规避情绪，但日元疲软（USD/JPY 159.704）暗示部分风险偏好。价格走势与负面宏观背景一致，未见新驱动，属于‘动能衰竭’状态。
【决策依据详情】Qlib模型预测DOGE和SOL相对强势（分数0.0067和0.0064），但技术面RSI均低于46，处于超卖边缘。ETH和SOL的鲸鱼代币流向为负（ETH -1,136,732.5 ETH，SOL -351,125.8 SOL），表示巨鲸在抛售，而稳定币流向也为负（ETH $-336,669，SOL $-116,951），表明资金离场，这与价格下跌相符。
【痛苦交易】基于爆仓多空比：SOL（1.86）、BTC（1.52）、ETH（1.13）显示多头正在被强平，而DOGE（0.47）和BNB（0.37）显示空头被强平。持仓L/S比中，DOGE（1.64/0.74）和SOL（1.76/0.83）的大户账户数多空比高，但持仓量比低，暗示散户多头拥挤，面临挤压风险。
【剧本选择】选择‘均值回归’剧本，因为技术指标（RSI低于40，价格偏离SMA50达-1.62%至-5.84%）和情绪指标（资金费率负值，如SOL -0.0140%）达到极端，但鲸鱼流向显示抛售，需谨慎。DOGE的Qlib排名第一且爆仓多空比低（0.47），提供短期反弹机会。
analysis_summary.en:
Narrative Synthesis (MANDATORY UNIQUE CONTENT):
1. [Narrative Validation]: Market is in a bearish regime with prices below SMA50 and daily RSI in low 40s, aligning with macro risk-off (strong DXY, high VIX). No new drivers; this is 'momentum exhaustion'.

[决策依据详情]：技术面：ETH RSI(14)=39.3（超卖区域），上影线比率79%（抛压显著），均线乖离度-3.94%（价格低于SMA50）；SOL RSI(14)=36.1（超卖），上影线比率50%（抛压），均线乖离度-5.85%（深度偏离）。量化：Qlib排名SOL第一（得分0.009），DOGE第二（得分0.0053），但Qlib数据过时（截至2026-03-28），需谨慎。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比：SOL为1.87（多头爆仓显著高于空头），ETH为1.15（多头略受压），BTC为1.52（多头受压），DOGE为0.46（空头爆仓更高）。结合持仓L/S比：SOL大户账户数比1.74（多头拥挤），ETH为1.53（多头略多），DOGE为1.67（多头拥挤）。SOL和ETH的多头可能处于强制平仓边缘，形成轧空风险。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为技术指标（RSI超卖、均线深度偏离）和鲸鱼流向（ETH积累）显示极端读数，价格可能反弹。拒绝TREND_FOLLOWING（趋势熊市，动量负值）和MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE（虽然有多头挤压风险，但鲸鱼数据不支持一致轧空信号）。

[Narrative Validation]: Market is in a bearish regime (all 1D RSI <46, price below SMA50), macro context shows VIX at 31.05 (extreme panic), DXY strengthening (100.15), risk-off sentiment. Price action aligns with macro risk aversion, but whale data diverges: ETH shows token withdrawal (+58,875.3 ETH) and stablecoin inflow (+$89,950), while SOL shows stablecoin outflow (-$68,703), indicating institutional accumulation in ETH and potential distribution in SOL. This creates sentiment divergence, with price down but some whales accumulating, hinting at a potential turning point.
[Decision Details]: Technicals: ETH RSI(14)=39.3 (oversold), upper wick ratio 79% (selling pressure), SMA deviation -3.94%; SOL RSI(14)=36.1 (oversold), upper wick ratio 50%, SMA deviation -5.85%. Quantitative: Qlib ranks SOL first (score 0.009), DOGE second (score 0.0053), but data is stale (as of 2026-03-28), use with caution.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation ratios: SOL 1.87 (longs heavily liquidated), ETH 1.15 (longs slightly pressured), BTC 1.52 (longs pressured), DOGE 0.46 (shorts liquidated more). Combined with L/S ratios: SOL whale account ratio 1.74 (crowded long), ETH 1.53 (slightly long-biased), DOGE 1.67 (crowded long). Longs in SOL and ETH may be near forced exits, creating squeeze risks.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook, as technical extremes (oversold RSI, deep SMA deviation) and whale flow (ETH accumulation) indicate potential reversal. Reject TREND_FOLLOWING (bearish trend, negative momentum) and MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE (while long squeeze risk exists, whale data lacks consistent squeeze signals).

[叙事校验]：当前市场处于熊市环境（全市场RSI_1D均低于46，价格低于SMA50），宏观背景显示VIX恐慌指数升至31.05（极端恐慌），美元走强（DXY=100.15），风险偏好下降。价格走势与宏观风险规避一致，但鲸鱼数据出现分歧：ETH显示巨鲸提币囤货（Token Flow=+58,875.3 ETH）和稳定币流入（+$89,950），而SOL显示稳定币流出（-$68,703），表明机构在ETH上可能进行隐藏吸筹，而在SOL上可能减持。这构成情绪分歧，价格下跌但部分鲸鱼在积累，暗示潜在转折点。
[决策依据详情]：技术面：ETH RSI(14)=39.3（超卖区域），上影线比率79%（抛压显著），均线乖离度-3.94%（价格低于SMA50）；SOL RSI(14)=36.1（超卖），上影线比率50%（抛压），均线乖离度-5.85%（深度偏离）。量化：Qlib排名SOL第一（得分0.009），DOGE第二（得分0.0053），但Qlib数据过时（截至2026-03-28），需谨慎。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比：SOL为1.87（多头爆仓显著高于空头），ETH为1.15（多头略受压），BTC为1.52（多头受压），DOGE为0.46（空头爆仓更高）。结合持仓L/S比：SOL大户账户数比1.74（多头拥挤），ETH为1.53（多头略多），DOGE为1.67（多头拥挤）。SOL和ETH的多头可能处于强制平仓边缘，形成轧空风险。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为技术指标（RSI超卖、均线深度偏离）和鲸鱼流向（ETH积累）显示极端读数，价格可能反弹。拒绝TREND_FOLLOWING（趋势熊市，动量负值）和MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE（虽然有多头挤压风险，但鲸鱼数据不支持一致轧空信号）。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Market is in a bearish regime (all 1D RSI <46, price below SMA50), macro context shows VIX at 31.05 (extreme panic), DXY strengthening (100.15), risk-off sentiment. Price action aligns with macro risk aversion, but whale data diverges: ETH shows token withdrawal (+58,875.3 ETH) and stablecoin inflow (+$89,950), while SOL shows stablecoin outflow (-$68,703), indicating institutional accumulation in ETH and potential distribution in SOL. This creates sentiment divergence, with price down but some whales accumulating, hinting at a potential turning point.
[Decision Details]: Technicals: ETH RSI(14)=39.3 (oversold), upper wick ratio 79% (selling pressure), SMA deviation -3.94%; SOL RSI(14)=36.1 (oversold), upper wick ratio 50%, SMA deviation -5.85%. Quantitative: Qlib ranks SOL first (score 0.009), DOGE second (score 0.0053), but data is stale (as of 2026-03-28), use with caution.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation ratios: SOL 1.87 (longs heavily liquidated), ETH 1.15 (longs slightly pressured), BTC 1.52 (longs pressured), DOGE 0.46 (shorts liquidated more). Combined with L/S ratios: SOL whale account ratio 1.74 (crowded long), ETH 1.53 (slightly long-biased), DOGE 1.67 (crowded long). Longs in SOL and ETH may be near forced exits, creating squeeze risks.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook, as technical extremes (oversold RSI, deep SMA deviation) and whale flow (ETH accumulation) indicate potential reversal. Reject TREND_FOLLOWING (bearish trend, negative momentum) and MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE (while long squeeze risk exists, whale data lacks consistent squeeze signals).

red_team_audit.en: If my thesis is wrong, the most likely reasons are: 1) Macro risks worsen further (VIX rises more or DXY strengthens), causing all assets to continue falling despite oversold technicals. 2) Whale flows could be lagging or misleading; ETH withdrawals might be for other purposes not accumulation, and SOL stablecoin outflow could signal larger selling pressure. 3) Qlib data is stale, and market conditions may have shifted; SOL's relative strength may have weakened. Data supporting opposite view: average momentum -0.0117 (negative), funding rates generally negative or low (e.g., SOL -0.0140%), indicating bearish leverage sentiment, and any bounce could be short-lived.

analysis_summary.zh:
[叙事校验]：当前市场处于熊市环境，BTC、ETH、SOL、BNB、DOGE均低于SMA50，RSI在37-46之间，显示整体疲软。宏观上，VIX恐慌指数升至31.05，美元指数走强，风险偏好下降。新闻面暂无重大驱动，价格走势与熊市背景一致，属于动能衰竭阶段，而非新信号触发。
[决策依据详情]：DOGE Qlib分数最高（0.013），排名第一，但RSI 45.93中性偏弱，资金费率0.0097%为正且Z-score高达96.04%，显示多头拥挤。SOL Qlib分数0.005排名第二，但RSI 37.77超卖，资金费率-0.0248%为负且Z-score -112.62%极端负值，空头情绪浓厚。ETH和SOL的鲸鱼代币流向均为负（充币抛售），稳定币流向也为负（资金离场），表明机构看跌。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比，DOGE为0.44（空头爆仓远多于多头），SOL为1.79（多头爆仓远多于空头），显示DOGE空头受压可能反弹，SOL多头受压可能续跌。持仓L/S比中，DOGE大户账户数比1.68（多头拥挤），SOL大户账户数比1.77（多头拥挤），但价格下跌中，存在多头挤压风险。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为SOL技术面超卖（RSI 37.77）、资金费率极端负值（-0.0248%）、爆仓多空比1.79显示多头已大量爆仓，抛压可能衰竭，存在反弹机会。DOGE虽Qlib强但多头拥挤且空头爆仓高，避免追高，以监控为主。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Market is in a bearish regime with BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, DOGE all below SMA50 and RSI 37-46, indicating overall weakness. Macro shows VIX at 31.05 (extreme panic) and DXY strengthening, reducing risk appetite. No major news drivers; price action aligns with bearish background, representing momentum exhaustion rather than new triggers.
[Decision Details]: DOGE has highest Qlib score (0.013) and rank 1, but RSI 45.93 is neutral-weak, funding rate 0.0097% positive with Z-score 96.04% showing crowded longs. SOL has Qlib score 0.005 rank 2, but RSI 37.77 oversold, funding rate -0.0248% negative with Z-score -112.62% extreme negative, indicating heavy short sentiment. Whale token flows for ETH and SOL are negative (to exchange selling), stablecoin flows negative (capital outflow), suggesting institutional bearishness.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation ratios, DOGE at 0.44 (short liquidations much higher than longs) and SOL at 1.79 (long liquidations much higher than shorts), indicating DOGE shorts may be squeezed for a bounce, SOL longs may be flushed for further decline. In L/S ratios, DOGE whale account ratio 1.68 (crowded longs) and SOL 1.77 (crowded longs), but with price falling, there is long squeeze risk.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook because SOL is technically oversold (RSI 37.77), has extreme negative funding (-0.0248%), and liquidation ratio 1.79 shows longs already heavily liquidated, suggesting selling pressure may exhaust for a bounce. DOGE, despite strong Qlib, has crowded longs and high short liquidations, so avoid chasing and monitor instead.

red_team_audit.zh: 如果我的判断错误，最可能的反向理由是：1) 整体熊市趋势可能延续，SOL超卖后可能继续下跌而非反弹，因为鲸鱼代币流向显示持续抛售（24h -345,470.8 SOL），机构看跌情绪强。2) DOGE的Qlib强势可能被多头拥挤和正资金费率拖累，导致价格下跌而非上涨。3) 宏观风险（VIX高、DXY强）可能压制所有风险资产，使均值回归失效。数据支撑：SOL鲸鱼评分-0.34（负面），ETH类似流向负，表明机构资金流出可能持续。
red_team_audit.en: If my thesis is wrong, the most likely reasons are: 1) Overall bearish trend may persist, SOL could continue falling instead of bouncing despite oversold conditions, as whale token flow shows ongoing selling (24h -345,470.8 SOL) and institutional bearishness. 2) DOGE's Qlib strength may be outweighed by crowded longs and positive funding, leading to price decline rather than rise. 3) Macro risks (high VIX, strong DXY) could suppress all risk assets, invalidating mean reversion. Supporting data: SOL whale score -0.34 (negative), ETH similar negative flows, indicating institutional outflow may continue.

contrary_signal_check.zh: 目前最明显的冲突信号：1) SOL的鲸鱼代币流向为负（充币抛售），稳定币流向也为负（资金离场），这与看涨反弹相矛盾。2) 整体市场趋势熊市，可能压制SOL的反弹幅度。解释：这些信号确实存在风险，但SOL的极端超卖（RSI 37.77）和空头情绪（资金费率负）已部分定价，爆仓多空比1.79显示多头痛苦可能出清，技术面反弹概率仍高，且仓位将严格控制风险（止损紧）。

Justification: These risks are acknowledged, but SOL's extreme oversold condition (RSI 37.77) and short sentiment (negative funding) may be partially priced in; liquidation ratio 1.79 shows long pain possibly flushed, technical bounce probability remains high, and position will be tightly risk-managed (tight stop-loss).

analysis_summary.zh:
[叙事校验]：当前市场处于熊市环境，BTC、ETH、SOL、BNB、DOGE均低于SMA50，RSI在37-46之间，显示整体疲软。宏观上，VIX恐慌指数升至31.05，美元指数走强，风险偏好下降。新闻面暂无重大驱动，价格走势与熊市背景一致，属于动能衰竭阶段，而非新信号触发。
[决策依据详情]：DOGE Qlib分数最高（0.013），排名第一，但RSI 45.93中性偏弱，资金费率0.0097%为正且Z-score高达96.04%，显示多头拥挤。SOL Qlib分数0.005排名第二，但RSI 37.77超卖，资金费率-0.0248%为负且Z-score -112.62%极端负值，空头情绪浓厚。ETH和SOL的鲸鱼代币流向均为负（充币抛售），稳定币流向也为负（资金离场），表明机构看跌。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比，DOGE为0.44（空头爆仓远多于多头），SOL为1.79（多头爆仓远多于空头），显示DOGE空头受压可能反弹，SOL多头受压可能续跌。持仓L/S比中，DOGE大户账户数比1.68（多头拥挤），SOL大户账户数比1.77（多头拥挤），但价格下跌中，存在多头挤压风险。
[剧本选择]：选择MEAN_REVERSION剧本，因为SOL技术面超卖（RSI 37.77）、资金费率极端负值（-0.0248%）、爆仓多空比1.79显示多头已大量爆仓，抛压可能衰竭，存在反弹机会。DOGE虽Qlib强但多头拥挤且空头爆仓高，避免追高，以监控为主。
analysis_summary.en:
[Narrative Validation]: Market is in a bearish regime with BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, DOGE all below SMA50 and RSI 37-46, indicating overall weakness. Macro shows VIX at 31.05 (extreme panic) and DXY strengthening, reducing risk appetite. No major news drivers; price action aligns with bearish background, representing momentum exhaustion rather than new triggers.
[Decision Details]: DOGE has highest Qlib score (0.013) and rank 1, but RSI 45.93 is neutral-weak, funding rate 0.0097% positive with Z-score 96.04% showing crowded longs. SOL has Qlib score 0.005 rank 2, but RSI 37.77 oversold, funding rate -0.0248% negative with Z-score -112.62% extreme negative, indicating heavy short sentiment. Whale token flows for ETH and SOL are negative (to exchange selling), stablecoin flows negative (capital outflow), suggesting institutional bearishness.
[Pain Trade]: Based on liquidation ratios, DOGE at 0.44 (short liquidations much higher than longs) and SOL at 1.79 (long liquidations much higher than shorts), indicating DOGE shorts may be squeezed for a bounce, SOL longs may be flushed for further decline. In L/S ratios, DOGE whale account ratio 1.68 (crowded longs) and SOL 1.77 (crowded longs), but with price falling, there is long squeeze risk.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MEAN_REVERSION playbook because SOL is technically oversold (RSI 37.77), has extreme negative funding (-0.0248%), and liquidation ratio 1.79 shows longs already heavily liquidated, suggesting selling pressure may exhaust for a bounce. DOGE, despite strong Qlib, has crowded longs and high short liquidations, so avoid chasing and monitor instead.

red_team_audit.zh: 如果我的判断错误，最可能的反向理由是：1) 整体熊市趋势可能延续，SOL超卖后可能继续下跌而非反弹，因为鲸鱼代币流向显示持续抛售（24h -345,470.8 SOL），机构看跌情绪强。2) DOGE的Qlib强势可能被多头拥挤和正资金费率拖累，导致价格下跌而非上涨。3) 宏观风险（VIX高、DXY强）可能压制所有风险资产，使均值回归失效。数据支撑：SOL鲸鱼评分-0.34（负面），ETH类似流向负，表明机构资金流出可能持续。
red_team_audit.en: If my thesis is wrong, the most likely reasons are: 1) Overall bearish trend may persist, SOL could continue falling instead of bouncing despite oversold conditions, as whale token flow shows ongoing selling (24h -345,470.8 SOL) and institutional bearishness. 2) DOGE's Qlib strength may be outweighed by crowded longs and positive funding, leading to price decline rather than rise. 3) Macro risks (high VIX, strong DXY) could suppress all risk assets, invalidating mean reversion. Supporting data: SOL whale score -0.34 (negative), ETH similar negative flows, indicating institutional outflow may continue.

Justification: These risks are acknowledged, but SOL's extreme oversold condition (RSI 37.77) and short sentiment (negative funding) may be partially priced in; liquidation ratio 1.79 shows long pain possibly flushed, technical bounce probability remains high, and position will be tightly risk-managed (tight stop-loss).

[决策依据详情]：技术面：DOGE RSI 45.93相对最高，Qlib分数0.013排名第一，但资金费率Z-score 96.04%极高，显示多头拥挤；SOL RSI 37.77超卖，资金费率负-0.0248%，Z-score -112.62%极端负值，空头拥挤；ETH和SOL鲸鱼代币流向均为负（充币抛售），稳定币流出，看跌信号强。量化分析：DOGE Qlib分数显著，但情绪指标矛盾；SOL Qlib分数0.005排名第二，技术超卖与空头拥挤结合。
[痛苦交易]：基于爆仓多空比：DOGE为0.44（空头爆仓远多于多头），显示空头已受挤压；SOL为1.78（多头爆仓远多于空头），显示多头正受痛苦；ETH为0.97接近平衡；BTC为1.29多头受压。持仓L/S比：DOGE大户账户数比1.70高，但持仓量比0.74低，散户可能看多但大户谨慎；SOL大户账户数比1.74高，持仓量比0.84低，类似结构。DOGE和SOL均存在多头拥挤风险，但SOL空头挤压机会更明显。
[剧本选择]：选择MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE剧本，因为SOL技术超卖（RSI 37.77）、资金费率极端负（-0.0248%）、空头拥挤（爆仓多空比1.78），且价格接近关键支撑，存在空头轧空机会。DOGE虽Qlib分数高，但资金费率Z-score极高，多头拥挤，风险大，故监控。

No major news drivers; price action aligns with macro, suggesting old news priced in, no new impulse.

DOGE and SOL have long crowding risks, but SOL short squeeze opportunity is clearer.
[Scenario Selection]: Choose MICROSTRUCTURE_SQUEEZE playbook, as SOL is oversold (RSI 37.77), funding extreme negative (-0.0248%), short crowded (liquidation ratio 1.78), and price near key support, offering short squeeze potential. [决策依据详情]：技术面：DOGE RSI 45.93相对最高，Qlib分数0.013排名第一，但资金费率Z-score 96.04%极高，显示多头拥挤；SOL RSI 37.77超卖，资金费率负-0.0248%，Z-score -112.62%极端负值，空头拥挤；ETH和SOL鲸鱼代币流向均为负（充币抛售），稳定币流出，看跌信号强。量化分析：DOGE Qlib分数显著，但情绪指标矛盾；SOL Qlib分数0.005排名第二，技术超卖与空头拥挤结合。
